name: ★ STACK · the controlled stand — resume the from-scratch checkpoint (watch)

hint: Design doc §12.3/§12.6. Seed 2 stands by ~30 min (falls 8 → 3 → 1 → 0/min); other seeds fall-cycle. Tick 'battery' with seeds 1-6 for the race. ≈ 380 MB of JSONL.

hint: Resume the find brain under R11: C norms shed, no falls, oscillation 12 → 11 mrad. Load-bearing — handing the find brain straight to R12c fails (§12.6).

hint: Resume the hunted brain under R12c: the efference rests at earned stillness, |dq| 11 → 0.1 mrad/tick, c 1.00. Watch it to see the oscillation stop.

name: PROBE · push test — 2 N shoves on the controlled stand every 60 s (watch)
hint: The (d) test, design doc §11. 0.1 s shoves on a rotating heading; ≥ 2 N knocks it over, the scaffold rescues, c collapses and is re-earned in ~38 s. Report gives the per-shove table.

name: PROBE · envelope — 1 N shoves on a saved brain (the catch limit)
hint: 1 N × 0.1 s is caught at 1–4° of tilt; 1.5 N is 50/50; 2 N topples. Change the force to bracket a brain's envelope; Report reads it. Point 'a saved brain' at the brain under test.

name: PROBE · byte-identity reference — r3, seed 6, 300 s (headless)
hint: The guard: run it before touching code, keep the JSONL, run it again after, cmp.

name: PROBE · scaffold — shove Pollen's standing policy (5 N every 4 s, watch)
hint: The RL reference: staggers and catches 5 N, knocked over at 10 N and stands back up. The envelope the brain is measured against.

name: PROBE · recovery harness — the stub brain that falls over (watch)
hint: A brain that fails, the scaffold that picks it up, and the hand-off between them. Tests the harness, not the substrate.

name: R19 · identification schedule: a settle before every pulse — STANDS 6/6 AND CATCHES 2 N (§14)
hint: Measured 2026-09-03: all six seeds consolidate inside 15 min (2-3 rescues in 2 h, tilt 0.35°, |u| 0.18) and catch 2 N shoves 35/36 (peak ~2.7°, back in 0.6 s); 3 N 13/36. From scratch, 2 h, saves the brain. The cause: the babble alternated legs inside one settle period, so the right leg and the head were identified from a body still moving — their lean rows had the wrong sign.

name: R19 · watch the catch — 2 N shoves on the R19 stand every 20 s (watch)
hint: Resume duck_r19_s2 under R19 and shove it: the ball stays green, tilt peaks ~2.7° and the body is back inside 0.6 s. Raise to 3 N to see where it still goes over (fore-aft first).
